title: Cheesy Gruyère Gougères
summary: A choux paste of water, butter and flour is cooked, beaten with eggs and Gruyère, piped into small mounds, topped with Parmesan and baked at two temperatures before drying in the oven.
equipment: 2 baking trays lined with baking paper

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt
large eggs, at room temperature, beaten

steps.title: Heat the oven
steps.text: Heat the oven to 220 °C (200 °C fan) and line two trays.

steps.title: Cook the paste
steps.text: Boil the water, butter, salt and cayenne, add the flour and stir 1-2 minutes until it forms a ball.

steps.title: Beat in the eggs
steps.text: Cool briefly, then beat in the eggs gradually until glossy, and add the Gruyère.

steps.title: Pipe
steps.text: Pipe about 32 small mounds and top with Parmesan.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake 15 minutes, lower to 180 °C for 15-20 minutes, then leave in the switched-off oven 10 minutes.

tips: Do not open the oven early or the puffs collapse.
Stop adding egg once the paste falls from the spoon in a thick V.
Bake from frozen for a ready-made party snack.
storage: Best warm on the day. Freeze cooled puffs for up to 1 month and reheat at 180 °C for 5-8 minutes. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
